IN PHOTOS: Delhi Police detain protesters marching against SIR towards EC
Delhi Police detained several protesters on Friday as a march against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls moved towards the Election Commission of India (ECI) headquarters in central Delhi. Restrictions under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), prohibiting large gatherings, were imposed in the area (PICS AND TEXT: PTI)
